predicted_observation: Across at least 30 recorded tasks, ResourceUsageRecord.unused_context as a fraction of context_sources correlates with retries more strongly than len(context_sources) does.
rationale: A manifest with many unused refs is evidence the assembler did not know what the task needed. If that is true, the unused fraction is a leading indicator that can be computed before the pass runs, whereas retries are only known after.
statement: Low context utilisation - a large fraction of manifest refs never touched - predicts retries better than manifest size does.
test_plan: Accumulate usage records over normal Company OS work until 30 tasks exist across at least three reasoning classes, then compare the two correlations. No new instrumentation is required: both quantities are already fields.
